# SetCameraStencilClear <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetCameraStencilClear:Void camera:Int32, clear:Int32, value:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |
| `clear` | In | Int32 | required | True to clear the stencil, False to keep it. |
| `value` | In | Int32 | `0` | What it is cleared to, from 0 to 255. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets whether a camera with a stencil ([SetCameraStencil](SetCameraStencil)) clears the stencil of its viewport when it starts drawing, and to which value. By default it clears it to 0. A camera that does not clear the stencil keeps what was drawn before, by the last frame or by a camera that drew earlier in the same [RenderWorld](RenderWorld). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraStencil camera, True
; Start with 1 everywhere: entities that test for 1 are drawn until something changes it.
SetCameraStencilClear camera, True, 1
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5
SetEntityStencil cube, 2, 1
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```
